title: Applet that shows keyboard shortcuts
line: A new Keyboard Shortcuts widget lists the global shortcuts, finds them by name or by keys, and runs the one you pick.
explanation: Global shortcuts could only be looked up in System Settings (and, since Plasma 6.5, one at a time through KRunner); there was no widget giving an overview of them. The new Keyboard Shortcuts widget (org.kde.plasma.keyboardshortcuts, in plasma-desktop next to the Shortcuts page) reuses that page's kglobalaccelmodel library to list every global shortcut that has a key, grouped by application or component, with a search field matching names and key combinations (e.g. "Meta+Ctrl+"); clicking or pressing Enter runs the shortcut, and a header button opens the Shortcuts settings page.

commits.message:
applets: add a Keyboard Shortcuts widget

There was no way to look up a global shortcut from the desktop without
opening System Settings. The new widget lists every global shortcut that
has a key, grouped by component, searchable by name or keys, and runs one.

BUG: 390067

media.caption: Before: searching the widget explorer for "shortcut" finds nothing
After: the Keyboard Shortcuts widget is in the widget explorer
Searching by name: "desktop" lists the matching shortcuts grouped by component
Searching by keys: "Meta+Ctrl+" lists every shortcut using those modifiers
Typing "overview" and pressing Enter runs Toggle Overview
